source: Existing hash-verified Raw250 valid-window pool values only; partial high-gamma group2 and line-length group5. No new EEG extraction. Preserve original Raw masks, including the disclosed 27 native-mask disagreements.
continuous_aggregation: Equal-seizure mean and population SD over present record-channel units. Float64 aggregation of the frozen float32 record scalars. No averaging across absent channels or padded records.
crossing_definition: Frozen float32 pre mean + 2 pre SD; first post center meeting >= threshold; fraction normalized by max absolute retained center. This is not clinical onset time.
crossing_eligibility: At least two pre and two post valid windows, all finite, pre population SD strictly positive. Zero-pre-SD units are quality missing, not early crossings.
crossing_aggregation: Coordinate1 mean fraction only among observed eligible crossings; NaN if none. Coordinate2 observed/eligible seizure count; 0 if eligible but no crossing, NaN if no eligible episode. Never average the no-crossing fallback into coordinate1.

patient_relative_views.unit_equivariant: Float64 within-patient NaN-aware mean and population SD per coordinate; divide by positive SD, otherwise1. No absolute SD floor or clipping.
patient_relative_views.legacy_diagnostic: Float64 within-patient NaN-aware mean and population SD; divide by max(SD,1e-8). Diagnostic comparator only, not a new trained arm.

inner_preprocessing: Reuse all20 original selection partitions; identity-only mapping to canonical archive. Fit imputer mean and population mean/SD exclusively on each selection TRAIN after patient-relative transform. SD0->1. Report CAL/CHOICE/HELD finite fraction and maximum absolute transformed values without labels or scores.
censoring_policy: Observed-crossing time missingness is legitimate censoring and separately reported; no minimum crossing prevalence. Its missingness cannot be counted as bad-source finite-rate failure. Crossing-rate coordinate must meet coverage gate.
group_eligibility: Source coverage/baseline eligibility and required coordinate coverage pass, and at least one coordinate has nonconstant fraction>=0.5 in every one of20 own selection TRAIN partitions. Unit-equivalent transform and all fitted input arrays finite after TRAIN-only imputation. No outcome-based choice.
permutation: Reverse channels and records independently; aggregate after inverse channel mapping and sorting records by frozen ledger ordinal must be exactly equal (NaN equal). Canonical summation order is mandatory.
unit_stress_scope: Multiply already-defined coordinates by positive unit scales; this tests representation normalization only, not raw voltage-unit invariance of log1p power.
prohibitions: no original Development or Outer results read
no patient/channel/record exclusion to pass gates
next_stage: Qualification is neither predictive contribution nor adoption. Any supervised study requires a separate prospective protocol, uniform matched preprocessing controls, and legal inner-only selection.
